name: ZunamiProtocol
fix_description: In lpPrice(), use a TWAP (time-weighted average price) mechanism instead of instantaneous totalHoldings()/totalSupply(). This prevents single-block donation attacks from immediately inflating the LP price used by downstream contracts like cacheAssetPrice.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash loan BUSD, swap into UN, abuse the pair via repeated transfer+skim reserve/accounting manipulation, then swap back and repay. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair mechanics and how skim can be abused with this token/pool behavior, so it is less obvious than a basic access-control bug but still not a deeply complex attack chain.
